title: Radiomics and deep learning models for predicting glioma p53 status: A diagnostic accuracy systematic review and meta-analysis of magnetic resonance imaging studies.
authors: Ahmadzadeh, Amir Mahmoud; Ashoobi, Mohammad Amin; Broomand Lomer, Nima; Vatanparast, Mahsa; Gheiji, Benyamin; Elyassirad, Danial; Faghani, Shahriar
one_liner_zh: 该文是MRI影像组学与深度学习预测胶质瘤p53状态的系统综述与Meta分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: To systematically investigate the diagnostic performance of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based radiomics and deep learning (DL) models for predicting p53 status in glioma and to generate pooled estimates for radiomics-based models. METHODS: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Embase, and Web of Science. Methodological quality was appraised using the QUADAS-2 and METRICS checklists. Pooled sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative likelihood ratios, diagnostic odds ratio, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) were calculated using a bivariate random-effects model. Subgroup and sensitivity analyses were undertaken to explore heterogeneity and robustness. Publication bias was assessed with Deeks' funnel plot asymmetry test. RESULTS: Seventeen studies were included in the systematic review. Of these, six studies were incorporated into the meta-analysis of exclusive radiomics models and five in the meta-analysis of combined radiomics approaches. Exclusive radiomics models yielded a pooled AUROC of 0.72, whereas combined models achieved a pooled AUROC of 0.89. Studies employing manual segmentation reported a significantly greater pooled specificity compared with those applying semi-automated segmentation methods. CONCLUSION: Radiomics features showed modest performance in predicting glioma p53 status when used alone. Incorporating complementary non-radiomic features could enhance model performance. Such approaches may support non-invasive patient stratification, aid clinical decision-making and prognostic assessment, and potentially decrease reliance on high-risk biopsy procedures.
abstract_zh: 目的：系统评估基于磁共振成像（MRI）的影像组学与深度学习（DL）模型在预测胶质瘤p53状态中的诊断性能，并生成影像组学模型的汇总估计值。方法：在PubMed、Scopus、Embase和Web of Science中进行了系统性检索。使用QUADAS-2和METRICS检查表评估方法学质量。采用双变量随机效应模型计算汇总敏感性、特异性、阳性似然比、阴性似然比、诊断优势比及受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。进行亚组和敏感性分析以探讨异质性和稳健性。使用Deeks漏斗图不对称检验评估发表偏倚。结果：系统评价共纳入17项研究。其中，6项研究纳入纯影像组学模型的荟萃分析，5项研究纳入联合影像组学方法的荟萃分析。纯影像组学模型汇总AUROC为0.72，而联合模型汇总AUROC为0.89。采用手动分割的研究报告的汇总特异性显著高于采用半自动分割方法的研究。结论：影像组学特征单独用于预测胶质瘤p53状态时表现中等。纳入互补的非影像组学特征可提升模型性能。此类方法可能支持非侵入性患者分层，辅助临床决策和预后评估，并可能减少对高风险活检操作的依赖。
